raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 28 extra raw rows are amendment rows: per the 2026-01-17 payments-source note, a corrected transaction repeats its txn_id with record_version incremented. silver_transactions keeps every version, so the corrected txn_ids appear more than once. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id (ingest_ts as tiebreaker) before the POSTED filter should give one correct row per transaction, and the gold tables read from silver so they correct automatically.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
